title: The forest track
paragraphs: Bima and his cousin planned to reach the waterfall before noon. The main path was {{1}} by a fallen tree, so they took a {{2}} track through the forest. It was slower, and Bima began to feel {{3}} that they were lost.
His cousin remained {{4}} and followed the sound of water. An hour later, they came out at the top of the falls, {{5}} but very happy.
